provenance.build: Release, C++20, TBB/ROCKSDB ON; FOLLY/TIKV/SPDK/GPU/RABITQ/LARGEVID OFF

checks: no duplicate or out-of-corpus returned IDs
final vs reopened round-2 results byte-identical

limitations: Independent randomized index builds; no fixed build seed or identical head/graph topology.
Shared host; same 16-CPU affinity, not isolated hardware or controlled OS page cache.
Final round2 is selected consistently; 200-query batch QPS/p99 are not long-run serving SLA.
Native reference includes full forced compaction before each insert batch; managed does not.
The three no-compaction native controls ran after the six AB/BA/AB reference runs, not interleaved.
No-compaction controls remove the explicit forced-compaction policy, not all backend/layout differences.
Native SaveIndex and node checkpoint offer different recovery semantics; save totals are not equivalent work.
Managed refine threshold is 2 vs native 0.4; necessary tenancy/recovery behavior is not disabled for a score.
Raw logs, full query-result CSVs, exact-truth payloads, binaries and databases remain in the artifact directory.
Recorded recipes preserve measured commands and historical paths; they are not a verified clean-host installer.
